review_note.source: harness checkpoint 1 review of sealed V2.1c tables; no new computation
review_note.first_cell_definition: already ordered by the sealed grid: b_crit in (0.260, 0.265]; max b is 0.2314 at w=0.05 (no pacemaker) and 0.2669 at w=0.1 (>= 1 pacemaker), so w_spontaneous in (0.05, 0.1]; min-window E rate-CV is 0.2554 at w=0.2 and 0.3767 at w=0.3, so w_CV in (0.2, 0.3); ordering SPONTANEOUS_BEFORE_CV
review_note.fraction_definition: pacemaker fraction is 0.0633 at w=0.2 and 0.1367 at w=0.3: f_sp <= 0.0633 gives SPONTANEOUS_BEFORE_CV and f_sp > 0.1367 gives CV_BEFORE_SPONTANEOUS from sealed values; only f_sp in (0.0633, 0.1367] needs the bisection
review_note.assumed: E rate-CV and pacemaker fraction are monotone in w between grid points (monotone on all sealed grid points)
review_note.consequence: the answer is set mainly by the choice of definition and f_sp, a reviewer decision the pre-execution spec must fix first; the question stands and is not superseded

reviewer_decision.definition: w_spontaneous = inf{w : exists i in the designed M=300 E population with r_i(I=0) > 0}; no population-fraction threshold
reviewer_decision.invariant: P_i[r_i(I=0) > 0] = 0 for every E cell of a designed population (zero-tonic persistence must not have an intrinsic pacemaker source)
reviewer_decision.method: resolve w_spontaneous in (0.05, 0.10] and w_CV=0.3 in (0.20, 0.30] directly by deterministic bisection; single-cell open loop; no network simulation
reviewer_decision.do_not_seal_from: the sealed-grid inequality plus a monotonicity assumption alone
